module: Flowgraph node "Setup Crawl" (category once_instant, crawl). Prepares a crawl course: loads the trail, teleports the vehicle to the start and loads the prefabs, without starting the timer (use Start Crawl). Input pins: trailId (trail path) and vehicleId (0 = player vehicle). Outputs: success, failed, isSetup.
notes: If trailId is empty: looks for the flowgraph variable "trailFile", then the first *.trail.json in the mission folder (mgr.activity.missionFolder).
Writes a lot of logs (tag SetupCrawl).

work.desc: Resolves the trail, calls bridge.loadCrawlTrail then bridge.setupCrawl(vehicleId, trail) and fills the outputs.
